voice.steering: Speak in a sharp, energetic, analytical business documentary voice.

world_anchor: Global economics, financial markets and corporate history
style_block: Cinematic editorial photography, crisp modern lighting, sleek architectural lines, rich navy and emerald color palette, subtle polished texture.
negative_block: No cartoon elements, no sci-fi fantasy, no cluttered garbage, no text, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no plastic skin.

boardroom_reportage.prompt: Corporate reportage photograph, glass and steel, available light, shallow depth of field.

ledger_macro.prompt: Macro of a ledger, banknotes or ticker tape, raking light, fine paper fibre detail.

editorial_isometric.prompt: Editorial isometric illustration of commerce, restrained two-colour palette, clean geometry.

trading_floor_silhouette.prompt: Silhouetted figures against a bank of glowing market screens.

vintage_industry.prompt: Mid-century industrial archive photograph, warm monochrome, factory or trading hall.
